prompt: A young male kitchen assistant in a white chef coat and white cap walks in fast from the right, slaps a silver vacuum-sealed sauce pouch onto the counter in front of the woman, glances at his watch, then turns and walks toward the door, his cap knocked crooked. Handheld camera tracks sideways with him, thick steam rolling in the kitchen behind. Fast continuous body movement, large displacement.

Inside a grand press conference hall, reporters raise cameras and microphones and surge forward, flash bulbs popping continuously. On stage a woman in a white dress gestures sideways. The huge LED screen behind the stage is plain dark blue and completely empty. A crane camera descends rapidly from above the crowd toward the stage. Constant camera and crowd movement.

A man in a dark suit rushes forward, grabs the woman's arm and pulls her back, leans close to her ear and speaks quietly, raises his other hand to block the camera, then steps sideways to stand between her and the lens. Handheld camera shakes with his motion, blurred people moving in the background. Strong body movement, clear displacement.
